title: Active-engine Top20 hit-count regime persistence
hypothesis: Does the previous target's exact active-engine Top20 hit count add information about the next Top20 hit count beyond Hypergeometric(40,20,5)?
alternative: p_t(k|j)=[200*q0(k)+N_{j,k}(t)]/[200+N_j(t)] with j=previous Top20 hit count; alpha=200 fixed.

metrics.gain: baseline loss minus model loss; positive favours model

limitations: Retrospective analysis was calculated before this protocol was persisted; it is exploratory, not preregistered.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout.
This predicts Top20 hit count only, not the winning numbers.
No correction across the full Q00-Q113 research family.
One prospective target is descriptive only; Q60 remains the promotion gate.
guardrails: No production scorer changes, no promotion, no merge.
